name: agent-verdict
description: Records Claude Code tool outcomes to a local, private ledger for later review, and at Stop/SubagentStop verifies the assistant's final message against that ledger. Verification sends a redacted evidence summary to the selected provider: prompt excerpts, a structural step list (tool, sanitized command, status, exit code), short redacted excerpts of tool output around failures, the redacted final message, and extracted claims; never a never-send path, never a full tool output, and file contents only if a tool printed them inside those excerpts. Set provider to local-only to disable that and never touch the network. Recording itself never touches the network.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow records everything and never blocks or nudges; enforce may block on strong evidence; off disables recording entirely.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which System One preset verifies a Stop's completion claims. local-only never calls a provider and only records evidence.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key for the selected provider. Falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY when unset. Never logged or written to the ledger.
